slide.blurb: Step 3: Set Up the MQTT Integration for Stream Deck
slide.example: # MQTT Integration mqtt: broker: "tcp://192.168.42.213:1883" clientid: "go-streamdeck" username: "mqtt" password: "homeassistant-mqtt-XXXXXXX" subscriptions: - topic: *"entities/+/state_change"* actions: - topic: *"entities/human_detector/state_change"* value: *on|off* *type: brightness* brightnessLevel: 0 - topic: "entities/human_detector/state_change" type: brightness value: off|on brightnessLevel: 1
